title: Country Swing Dancing **THE BASICS Pt. 2**
teacher: Grant & Shalee - King & Queen of Country Swing

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates partner country swing movements at speed, breaks them down step-by-step for lead and follow roles, and then practices them slowly before combining them into a full routine.

practices.what: The teacher introduces the first move variation as a building block off the basic backslide.
The teacher repeats the breakdown of the first move from the starting position.
The teacher introduces the second move as an intermediate variation building on the backslide.
The teacher repeats the step-by-step breakdown of the second move at a slow pace.
The teacher runs through the second move again slightly faster while keeping it slow.
The teacher demonstrates both moves pieced together with music at full speed.

moments.says: The teachers introduce themselves as the king and queen of country swing and welcome viewers to their channel.
The teacher warns that the next move is in the intermediate range and slightly more complicated, encouraging the learner to stick with them.
The teachers hope the learners had a blast learning the moves and invite them to comment below with any questions.

mentor.what_stays: The learner is left feeling encouraged and capable of mastering fun country swing variations through clear, step-by-step guidance.
